en: Oops, you got me.
Yes, I like men like that too.
Really? Aw, geez, haha!
What turns you on?
Well... I like it when a man checks his watch.
There's something sexy about a man rolling up his sleeve!
I see. Most people nowadays check the time on their phones, so I guess compared to that, checking time on a watch would seem refined.
Oh, so you really do get me!
You're so weird. How is that sexy?
I can tell if a man is good at his job by seeing how casual he is at checking time.
Huh? Really!?
Also, I can tell his income by the kind of watch he wears. The first time I meet a man I always make sure to check his watch!
Wow, you've really thought about this.
Are you the type to make the first move if you find someone you like?
Oh no, I would never be so improper.
So you wait for the guy to declare interest? What if they don't feel the same way?
In that case, I would do what it takes to make him like me.
Does that turn out well?
Oh, it's simple. All I do is get him into a mood where it's easy for him to confess his feelings for me.
I don't want a man who isn't comfortable enough to take the initiative to date me.
Hm. I guess I get that, but is that really any less "improper"?
Shion-chan, tell me about yourself.
Oh? What would you like to know?
Do you have any special skills?
Let's see. I know a few languages, and I also have a fondness for the piano.
What languages?
English and French. And I know enough Italian and German to get by without too much trouble when I travel there.
That's amazing. That must come in handy.
Once you know basic grammar, it's just a matter of picking up vocabulary. And the others are a breeze after learning English.
Lots of ball players go to the majors these days, so it doesn't hurt to know English.
Right now I'm studying Chinese, but the pronunciation is really quite difficult. I'm not making very good progress.
You're learning another one!? Incredible!
You can play the piano? I bet you've been taking lessons for a long time.
Yes, but I stopped when I was in middle school. I'm actually not sure whether I can still play or not.
I guess not many people stick with the piano for very long.
I may actually be better on the guitar than I am on the piano.
You play guitar? Whoa, I'd never have guessed! Are you in a band or something?
When I say guitar, I mean a nylon string acoustic. I learned musical styles like bossa nova and tango from my father.
Oh, all right. I get you. Your dad sounds like he was a really cool guy.
Quite! That's why I gave up the piano. I was too hooked on guitar.
Wow. I'd love to hear you play.
What are your worst traits, Shion-chan? Like, any bad habits or something like that?
My, what an awful thing to ask!
Hey now, I was just curious. I think it's good to think about that sort of thing every now and then.
I see. Well... I suppose I feel I'm a bit too tall for a woman.
Yeah? How tall are you, anyway?
170 centimeters, exactly.
That is tall! But your body proportions are great, so I wouldn't worry. Maybe they're too good! You're like a model or an actress!
You really think so? Oh, you're just trying to butter me up!
No, I really mean it! I'd love walking next to a tall beauty like you.
Got any quirks?
Oh no, my parents refined those out of me when I was a child.
Yeah, that makes sense. I guess your family was a fairly strict one.
Because of that, I'm fairly sensitive to the quirks of other people. I spot them a lot in my customers while I'm talking to them.
Since they're involuntary habits, I suppose they can't be held accountable. But I would like them to fix the really bad ones that upset me.
Do I have any?
Hmm. That's an interesting question.
Aww, tell me! I want to know!
You know, there's something I've been wondering about you.
Mind telling me what your measurements are?
Oh my! Shinada-san, have you been wondering that this whole time? I'm quite disappointed in you.
What's wrong with that?
I am not going to answer that. I cannot believe you would be so rude!
Yikes, you're sensitive.
Sorry, professional curiosity. You've just got such a great body, Shion-chan.
Well, I do take care to maintain my proportions.
I'll bet! You've got curves in all the right places and none where you don't want 'em! You could be a model!
Oh, I wouldn't go that far! My measurements are 88, 59, 86.
I knew it! Looks like my guess was spot on!
How much money do you have?
I bet the pay here is pretty good. On top of everything else, you must be loaded.
I've never been asked something so rude! I am not going to answer that!
Geez, was it that bad a question?
When did you first have sex?
Actually, I'm still a virgin.
The jet set elite overseas may fool around and play the field, but I am not a woman of such loose morals.
I intend to remain a virgin until after I walk down the aisle.
You're so pure. A real proper lady.
Naturally. Marriage partners must be chosen carefully.
I have a friend who had to marry this good-for-nothing who got her pregnant. I will not fall into that same trap!
I suppose guys can be gold diggers too. Uh, I mean... I wouldn't fool around either, nope!
Don't be so uptight. Most girls aren't really concerned with that these days.
I am my own person. Is there any reason why I must conform to others' behavior?
I'm just saying maybe it's good to get some experience before you get married. Make sure you're compatible and share the right interests.
You needn't concern yourself with such things, Shinada-san! I really shouldn't even discuss such indecent matters like this with a man.
You sure are stubborn.
Shinada-san, welcome! I'm delighted that you've requested me!
Did you come to see me? Have you taken an interest in me, I wonder?
I've been waiting for you, Shinada-san! Today is going to be so much fun!
My name is Shion. It's a pleasure to meet you.
Shion-chan, huh? Hey, mind if I get your business card?
Oh, not at all.
Here you are! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
And may I have your name?
Tatsuo Shinada!
Shinada-san, it's a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
The pleasure's all mine, beautiful!
Thank you for coming!
This is just for you, Shinada-san.
My, you smell quite nice today! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>You have wonderful taste in cologne, Shinada-san.
Look how handsome you are! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default> Your fashion sense is impeccable, Shinada-san.
Those clothes look quite nice on you! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Are those the only clothes you own?
That's an... interesting fashion choice.
Honestly, what were you thinking, coming here dressed like that?
I'll have this, please.
Oh my, are you certain?
Shinada-san, you're so generous!
Oh, you'd like to try your luck? Very well!
All right. We'll hold on to your bottle for you, Shinada-san.
Very well. A house bottle it is, then.
May I have a drink as well?
Your glass is empty. Shall I get you some more?
(Uh oh, I don't have the money.)
Sorry. No can do right now.
Would you mind if I had another drink?
I'm sort of hungry.
Certainly!
Oh my, you like that too? <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
You actually like that? We have different tastes, it seems.
All right. Another time, perhaps.
Shall we play the chocolate stick game?
For real!? You bet!
Allow me to feed it to you. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Over here please!
I'll make it for you now.
My, you're an impressive drinker!
Allow me to refill your glass.
I'll contact you in a little while. Would you mind passing the time somewhere until then?
Very well, allow me to get your check.
No, I have to be on my way.
May I join you for another drink?
(I've run out of stuff to talk about. Guess I should get going.)
I'll be on my way.
Do you want to go out later?
That's... That's a no, huh? Ahaha, I figured.
Asking me again isn't going to change my answer.
After this, you mean?
My apologies, Shinada-san, but I have a prior engagement today. Ask me again sometime, okay?
That's too bad, but no hard feelings.
I'm not really up for that sort of thing today, I'm afraid.
All right. Maybe some other time, if you want.
Perhaps after we've gotten to know each other better? It's a bit improper, asking me so soon.
Yeah, I guess it kind of is.
Oh, I suppose. I don't mind spending a little time with you.
You really mean it!? Awesome!
Do you want to go out with me that badly? Then I suppose I can make a little time for you.
I'd love to spend more time with you, Shinada-san!
Aww, come on, you're making me blush!
Of course I'd like to! I would never turn down an invitation from you, Shinada-san!
Happy to hear it!
I just happen to have some free time. Why not?
Haha, lucky me.
What is it, Shinada-san?
Oh, I love it! Shinada-san, how did you know? <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
I had my eye on this! Thank you so much!
Are you certain? I'll take good care of it!
What in the world is this? I have no idea what I would even do with it.
Oh? This is for me?
You've already given me one of these. Have you forgotten?
Shinada-san, please do come and see me again.
Of course! I'll ask for you next time!
Oh my, really? Then I'll be waiting for you!
I had a lovely time today!
Thank you so much for today! See you soon!
You too!
Come back soon! I'll be waiting!
I'll see you later! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
I can't wait!
